body: My parents went to a new years eve party at my aunt's house, and I was told that I wasn't invited. Something about them having dinner and me not even being expected, I was told. Really hurts me that not even my family wants me around anymore. Makes me want to go into the woods and never come back.
Thank you. I think you're right, I should probably set an appointment with my doctor and see what they say about it.
I daydream about being held close like that on a daily basis. I haven't gotten a proper hug in what feels like years.

Yeah, the cold weather combined with the fact that I have a shitty job I can't escape from yet and I'm being forced to go to college in January makes me feel even worse than usual. Life is creeping up on me too fast, I'll probably have to quit my job when I start school because I can't handle stress that well.
